attributes.name: Animated Horde
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to draw 2 random monsters that do not have either the Basic or Elite trait from the box. If you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, bury this card instead.

Discard this card to explore your location. During this exploration, on each of your combat checks, you may recharge a monster to add 3d4.
